financial_benefits.name: Pudhumai Penn Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Financial Assistance
financial_benefits.provider: Tamil Nadu Higher Education & Social Welfare Department
eligibility: Gender: Female
Studied Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Enrolled in Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Professional course
documents_required: Class 6 to 12 School Study / TC Certificates
College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID Card

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Pudhalvan Higher Education Financial Assistance for Boys
financial_benefits.provider: Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Gender: Male
Studied Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
Enrolled in Undergraduate Degree, Engineering, Medicine, Diploma, or ITI
documents_required: College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID Card

financial_benefits.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
eligibility: Gender: Female (Head of Family)
Family annual income below ₹2.5 lakh
Annual electricity consumption below 3,600 units
Valid Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card holder
documents_required: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)

financial_benefits.name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP Capital Subsidy)
financial_benefits.provider: Department of Industries and Commerce (DIC), Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: 25% Capital Subsidy up to ₹3,75,000 (Loan up to ₹15 Lakhs)
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
Age 18 to 45 years
Passed minimum Class 8th standard
Family income not exceeding ₹5 Lakhs per annum

financial_benefits.name: NEEDS Capital Subsidy & 3% Interest Subvention
financial_benefits.provider: MSME Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: 25% Capital Subsidy up to ₹75,000,000 + 3% Interest Subsidy
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
First-generation educated entrepreneurs aged 18 to 45
Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Vocational Training completion
Project cost between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹5 Crores
documents_required: Land / Building Lease or Ownership Deed

financial_benefits.name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Cashless Coverage (CMCHIS)
financial_benefits.provider: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
All family members listed in Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card
Annual family income below ₹1.20 Lakhs

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship for BC / MBC / Minority Students
financial_benefits.provider: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes & Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
Students belonging to BC / MBC / DNC / Minority communities
Annual family income less than ₹2.5 Lakhs
Enrolled in Post-Matric degree, polytechnic, or professional courses

financial_benefits.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Financial Benefit Scheme
financial_benefits.provider: Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Gender: Female (Pregnant women)
Pregnant women aged 19 years and above
Applicable for first two deliveries
Registered in PICME portal within 12 weeks of pregnancy

financial_benefits.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP Margin Money)
financial_benefits.provider: KVIC / KVIB / District Industries Centre, Tamil Nadu
financial_benefits.amount: 15% to 35% Margin Money Subsidy (up to ₹17.5 Lakhs)
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
Individuals aged 18 years and above
Project cost up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing / ₹20 Lakhs for service

financial_benefits.name: Tamil Nadu Unemployment Assistance Scheme for Educated Youth
financial_benefits.provider: Department of Employment and Training, Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Gender: Both (Male & Female)
Unemployed educated youth registered in Employment Exchange for 5+ years
Age between 18 and 40 years (45 years for SC/ST)
Family income less than ₹72,000 per annum
